let value: string | number = 'a';
type Alias = typeof value;
const alias: Alias = 1;
const variable: typeof value = 1;
interface Data { property: typeof value }
const data: Data = {property: 1};
class DeclaredField { uninitialized!: typeof value; }
new DeclaredField().uninitialized = 1;
function local() {
  let narrow: string | number = 'local';
  const arrow = (argument: typeof narrow) => argument;
  const expression = function(argument: typeof narrow) { return argument; };
  const object = {method(argument: typeof narrow) { return argument; }};
  const klass = class {method(argument: typeof narrow) { return argument; }};
  arrow(1);
  expression(1);
  object.method(1);
  new klass().method(1);
}
const record: {member: string | number} = {member: 'text'};
if (typeof record.member === 'string') {
  type Narrow = typeof record.member;
  const property: Narrow = 1;
}
